title_hi: मिन्नी बंदर की फलों वाली पिकनिक
description: Iss song mein bache fruits ke naam aur unke colours ke baare mein seekhenge. Chintu aur Mithu ke saath milkar Minnie ki picnic enjoy karein!
learning: Identify five different fruits and their colors through a fun, musical picnic.

scenes.text:

फलों की पिकनिक है कितना आराम!
scenes.image_prompt: A cute orange baby elephant with a blue scarf and a tiny green parrot with a red cap dancing in a sunny park.

scenes.text:
Red apple and yellow mango, 
Ready to eat, let us go!
